audit.why: Beat Drop (E) is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s — a rank-1 miss is an 11s open window. Stage Presence resets Seraphine's auto after every 3rd spell cast near an ally, so the wind-up auto is the tell to disengage before the burst, not the spell cast itself.
